title: 'Save my measurements' leaves out the measurements the gym's trainer took
what: Measurements a trainer takes at the gym come to the member's phone, show on the Body page graph and list, and are kept after the member leaves the gym because they are about the member's own body. 'Save my measurements' builds its file only from what the member typed in, so the trainer's readings are missing from the file. A member who leaves the gym and saves the file to take elsewhere loses those readings without being told.
expected: The saved file holds every reading the Body page shows, including the trainer's (marked as taken by the gym), or the save screen says the gym's readings are not included.
who: members whose gym trainer records their measurements
how_often: every time they save their measurements
fix_line: Add the gym's readings to the measurements file, on the days the member has none of their own, as the Body page does

title: 'Save my history' and 'Ask your own AI' include the sample workouts as the member's own
what: While the sample data is loaded, a member can already log their own workouts next to it. 'Save my measurements' refuses to save while the sample is loaded, and Health Connect, reminders, the finish note and muscle tips all leave the sample workouts out. 'Save my history' writes every workout on the phone, and 'Ask your own AI' copies the last 4 weeks of every workout, with no check for the sample. The member's file, or the text pasted into their own AI, then mixes made-up workouts with real ones.
expected: Both leave the sample workouts out (or refuse while the sample is loaded and say why), the same way 'Save my measurements' does.
who: members who start logging before removing the sample data
how_often: every history save or AI copy while the sample is loaded
fix_line: Leave the sample workouts out of the history file and the AI copy, as Health Connect already does

items.reason: Switches: coach (off) + member coach-notes, nutrition (off), trainerPlans Pro gate (gym plans, WOD, trainer measurements, diets), Muscle tips setting and its muted groups, Include photos in my backup. Statuses: easy week of a followed plan, left or switched gym, sample data loaded, balance focus block. Automations: gym plan/WOD/body sync, Forgotten Finish pause, start-up repairs, photo backup refresh.

Easy week -> Targets, coach's today, finish note, muscle tips, Home insight. Muscle tips switch/mutes -> Charts Balance check. Trainer measurements -> Body page, Save my measurements. Left gym -> plan folders, WOD folder, diets, trainer videos. Sample data -> both exports, AI copy, Health Connect, reminders, finish note. Photo backup -> photo add/delete, Erase all data.

Read correctly: easy week by Targets, coach's today, finish note and muscle tips; leaving the gym relabels plan and WOD folders and drops diets; photo delete and Erase clear backup copies; coach note stops with the coach off. Home insight ignores the easy week but only shows with the coach on (off now), so not raised. Missing reads: Balance check ignores Muscle tips mutes (existing finding), measurements file skips trainer readings, history file and AI copy skip no sample data.
Rule applied: 2 new findings, 1 reused (Balance check vs Muscle tips mutes).
